notes.method: Each feature uses only games before the one predicted, added on top of the full pre-game logit (ratings + draft). Fitted on the first 70% of games by date, judged on the last 30%. Adopt only if LR > 3.84 and held-out Brier improves, then re-run inside the whole model.
notes.comfort: player record on the picked hero (shrunk); comfort70 = 15+ games at 70%+; familiar = games on the hero
notes.comfortDelta: the player's recency-weighted record on the picked hero minus their own recency-weighted average (half-life 240 days), pooled across every league in our history; comfortPicks = such picks with 4+ weighted games and +10 points, counted per draft
notes.experience: career games in our data; intlExp = international games; expBigStage = experience gap only in playoffs, finals and international events
notes.careerWR: career game win rate shrunk toward 50% (20-game prior); careerWRuncertain = only while a team has under 10 series or under 5 games this season
notes.archLane: archetypes rebuilt from each player's earlier Season 18 games (3+ games); lane-opponent pairs. archMix = whole-team mix, all 25 cross pairs. Research games joined to ours by fuzzy team names: 453 of 557 Season 18 games
notes.menaDeaths: team deaths per game in earlier MENA S10 games
notes.s16Prior: Season 16 lines from the MPL PH staff stat posts (lane KDA percentile, win rate shrunk), used only for later S17-S18 PH games
notes.contextScore: comfortDelta, comfortPicks, expBigStage, careerWRuncertain, careerWR and experience, each standardised on the training games, signed by its training fit, averaged into one score

notTested.gkLongGames: game length is not known before a game
notTested.turtles: the model does not use turtle control
notTested.staffAllTime: the staff all-time and M-series totals include later games and would leak the future; career numbers were rebuilt from our own games instead
